title: fix(app-shell): offer switch-source-off and open-in-Studio on the packaged flow clone result
body:
Fixes #13270
Clause-②: no

## What changed

Setup › Packaged automation: after a successful clone, the result keeps the server's notice verbatim and now offers the two next steps the sharing-rule clone dialog (`SharingRuleCloneDialog`, `Switch "{source}" off`) already offers at the same moment:

- **Switch "SOURCE" off** — calls the SAME packaged-flow toggle the row's switch calls (`POST /api/v1/automation/NAME/toggle` with `enabled: false`), for the flow the admin cloned from. The toggle request is factored into one `requestToggle` that both the row switch and this offer use; on success the row reads off (and the runtime states are re-read, as after any toggle), and the result reads "The packaged flow "LABEL" is switched off." A refusal renders the server's message verbatim beside the button, and the button stays offered. When the source is already off, no switch-off is offered (the done sentence shows instead).
- **Open the clone in Studio** — a router `Link` to the package-less Studio scope, built by `studioOrgScopePath({ type: 'flow', name })`, i.e. `/studio/~org/automations` opened on the clone (objectui#11553). Measured on `main` before linking: `studioRoutes` in `apps/console/src/components/StudioRoute.tsx` declares the `~org` leg and the generic `:packageId/:tab` leg serves the pillar; `StudioDesignSurface` already navigates to this same path after a save.

The clone itself, its `draft` status and its server behaviour are unchanged (ADR-0126: clone and disable stay independent primitives; the offer is the page's own knowledge of the row that was clicked, not lineage).

Three new pack keys in all ten locales: `packagedAutomation.cloneSwitchSourceOff`, `.cloneSourceOff`, `.cloneOpen`. The `de` values carry no quote pair, so the `de-quote-pairing-3876` span counts do not move.

## Tests

New `describe` in `PackagedAutomationPage.test.tsx` (the page's `renderPage` now mounts in a `MemoryRouter`):

- (a) after a clone the notice stays and `Switch "Notify owner" off` is offered; pressing it sends exactly one `POST .../automation/pkg_notify/toggle` with `{ enabled: false }`; the source row's switch reads unchecked and the done sentence replaces the offer.
- (b) the open link's href starts with `/studio/~org/automations` and names the clone.
- (c) a 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` on the switch-off renders the server's sentence (role alert) inside the next-steps area; the offer stays enabled and the source stays on.
- (d) CONTROL: cloning the already-off `pkg_escalate` offers no switch-off and sends no toggle.

Ablation (one-shot, through `ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor `) : cloneSourceRow ? (` → `) : false ? (`, i.e. the offer is never rendered): blob `f4aa90e11d32` → `d16b14152301`, run: `Tests 2 failed | 23 passed (25)` — (a) and (c) red, (d) green; restore: blob after restore == blob at HEAD `f4aa90e11d32`, `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Local verification at `ba93526a19`

- Closure build `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...' --concurrency=2`: 28/28 tasks, exit 0.
- `type-check` for `@object-ui/i18n` and `@object-ui/app-shell` (both run `tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`; the latter includes `src/**/*.test.tsx`): exit 0.
- Targeted vitest, `--maxWorkers=1`, under the shared lock: the three `views/setup` packaged files (46 passed); ten `packages/i18n/src/__tests__` pack scans (key parity, en/zh parity, de quote pairing, untranslated identity, machine-locale census, aria-label census, ellipsis glyph, placeholder spelling, ar orthography, i18n) (152 passed); `scripts/__tests__` i18n dead-keys, call-site-keys, en-drift (323 passed).
- Declared to CI: the full `packages/app-shell/` and `packages/i18n/` directories (not run whole here: shared container lock).
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the 12 changed TS files: 0 errors, 1 warning (`react-hooks/set-state-in-effect` on the unchanged `setLoadError(null)` in the load effect, present on the base too). Narrowing proof: population = the changed files; count 12 read from the JSON output; the config enables no type-aware linting, so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.
- Pre-tsc battery, exit 0 each: `check:phantom-deps`, `self-import`, `unreferenced-sources`, `doc-example-readers`, `handler-key-reads`, `side-effects-array`, `element-data-source-declaration`, `spec-symbols`, `action-forward-parity`, `designer-field-key-parity`, `icon-record-names`, `i18n-keys`, `i18n-drift`, `i18n-designer-parity`, `control-bytes`, `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.mjs`, `check-changeset-fixed.mjs`, `check-changeset-presence.mjs`.
- `check:spec-floors`: exit 1, `no-artifact` for packages outside the built closure (expected on a partial build; recorded, not fixed).

## Acceptance notes

- The switch-off offer names the source by its LABEL (as the row's switch aria-label does), not its machine name; the existing ancestry pin that the status region never shows `pkg_notify` stays green unchanged. The offer lives outside the `role="status"` region so the announcement stays the server's notice.
- Using the row's own switch on the source still clears the clone result, as before this change.
